name: CanvasTTY Context
description: Project rules for agents: rules for you, an organization, a project or a saved task, imported from AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor rules, README, .editorconfig, Prettier/ESLint and CSS tokens, and sent to Claude Code, Codex or Grok when you launch them with "Send rules". Orchestrators ask which rules apply to a folder.
description.ru: Правила проектов для агентов: правила для вас, организации, проекта или сохранённой задачи, импорт из AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, правил Cursor, README, .editorconfig, Prettier/ESLint и CSS-токенов; Claude Code, Codex или Grok получают их при запуске с «Send rules». Оркестраторы узнают, какие правила действуют для папки.
author: CanvasTTY contributors

services.title: Context
services.description: Resolves the project rules for a launch and answers orchestrators' rule questions.

fields.label: Only this category (security and dependencies always)

tools.name: rules_for
tools.description: Which of the person's project rules apply to a folder (default: your own folder), optionally for a saved task or one category: the rules in priority order (launch instruction, task, project, organization, user, defaults), the exact text an agent would get, and launchOptions to pass to spawn_agent so a subagent (claude, codex or grok) gets them at launch.

folder.description: Full path of the folder the work happens in. Default: the calling agent's folder.

task.description: A saved task of that folder's project, by name.

category.description: Only rules of this category (security and dependencies rules always): design, architecture, code-style, security, testing, deployment, documentation, business-rules, naming, dependencies or communication.

provider.description: Size the text for this agent: claude (default), codex or grok.

contributions.title: Project rules
contributions.description: Projects, rules, tasks and convention imports for agents.
